user.title: Add Open Data
user.description: Choose how you want Open Data to find the public data source. Open Data inspects sources and datasets first; Home Assistant entities are created only after you explicitly activate the prepared dataset. You can refine variables, records, timestamp meaning, measurement categories, timezone, and structure later from Configure.

menu_options.local: Find useful data for my area
menu_options.website: Add from a website or dashboard
menu_options.known: Add a known portal, dataset, API, or ID

local.title: Find useful data for my area
local.description: Sources are ranked using your Home Assistant location, formal coverage, practical relevance, and extraction-test history. Only sources with a supported import path are offered. Open Data prepares the selected catalog in the background, then lets you choose and inspect datasets before anything is activated.

website.title: Find the data behind a website
website.description: Paste a public webpage, dashboard, chart, portal, or data page. Open Data inspects bounded public page evidence for upstream APIs, files, feeds, spreadsheets, and embedded data services without executing arbitrary page JavaScript. Resolved datasets are prepared for review before Home Assistant entities are activated.

resolved_source.title: Choose an upstream data source
resolved_source.description: Open Data found these likely machine-readable sources behind the page. Choose the source that should be inspected next. A resolved source may still require provider/feed support before it can be prepared; preparation itself does not create entities.

known.title: Add a known data source
known.description: Paste a portal, catalog, dataset page, resource/API URL, or dataset ID. Dataset links prepare only that dataset; portal roots start bounded catalog discovery. Open Data infers the initial variables and interpretation, then asks you to activate the prepared dataset before runtime updates or entities begin.

data.source_location: Portal, dataset, API URL, or ID
data.portal_url: Portal URL for a bare ID (optional)

portal.title: Discover public datasets
portal.description: Enter an institution's public data portal URL. Open Data will prepare and cache the site structure. Large catalogs and file resources can take several minutes; you can leave this screen and return later.

dataset.title: Add a dataset directly
dataset.description: Paste a CKAN or Socrata dataset page, resource/API URL, or dataset ID. A portal URL is required when entering an ID by itself. The dataset is inspected and prepared before activation.

data.portal_url: Portal URL for a bare ID (optional)

discover.title: Choose datasets to prepare
discover.description: Found {count} ranked datasets on {portal} using {provider}. Select datasets to inspect and prepare. Open Data will infer fields, observation time, freshness, stable records, timestamp semantics, measurement behavior, and structural relationships. This step does not create entities; prepared datasets are shown for explicit activation next.

activate.title: Activate prepared datasets
activate.description: Prepared {count} dataset(s): {datasets}. Nothing from this selection is running yet. Submit this step to create the Home Assistant config entry or entries and begin runtime updates/entity creation. You can refine the inferred configuration afterward from Configure.

prepare.title: Prepare site catalog
prepare.description: Preparing and checking the site catalog in the background with rate-limited requests. Large catalogs can take a few minutes. You may close this dialog and submit the same source later; completed preparation is saved. No time-series downloads, entities, or regular updates begin until you explicitly activate a prepared dataset.

progress.prepare_catalog: Checking supported catalog pages at a safe rate and saving working datasets for later selection

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the supplied source.
error.invalid_reference: The source reference could not be recognized or resolved. Check the URL or provide the portal URL for a bare ID.
error.unsafe_source: The supplied source was blocked by Open Data's network safety checks.
error.invalid_dataset: The portal or selected dataset is invalid.
error.no_datasets: No suitable queryable datasets were discovered on this portal.
error.no_machine_source: No public machine-readable source was found in the bounded page evidence. The page may use an unsupported embed, authenticated API, or JavaScript-only data loading.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This open data resource is already configured.
abort.no_local_sources: No source profiles in the current audited corpus were relevant to the configured Home Assistant location.
abort.no_pending_datasets: No prepared datasets are waiting for activation. Start again and prepare a dataset first.

menu.title: Configure Open Data
menu.description: This import is already running with Open Data's inferred settings. Change only the part you want to improve.

init.title: Adjust inferred fields
init.description: Open Data created the import using automatic inference. Dataset structure: {kind}. The current assignments are preselected below; change only what you want to improve, such as which columns describe location, time, measurements, or context.

structure.title: Advanced identity and display paths
structure.description: Use this only when automatic structure inference needs correction. Structural relationships are edited separately as child → parent dyads; these legacy path/identity controls are retained for advanced cases.

relationships.title: Adjust structural relationships
relationships.description: Open Data found {relationship_count} structural child → parent dyads; {hidden_count} are outside this bounded review. Move known dyads among Perfect, Imperfect/overlapping, None, and Unknown. Perfect means each true child identity belongs to one parent; repeated labels under different parents may therefore imply a parent-qualified identity rather than bad data. Multiple perfect parents are allowed. Current warnings: {warnings}.

records.title: Adjust imported records and measurements
records.description: These are the current inferred/imported choices. Observation time: {temporal_status} using {timestamp_strategy} ({timestamp_confidence} confidence). Timezone: {timezone} ({timezone_source}). {stale_count} measurements are currently classified stale and are excluded by default unless you select them. Record mode: {record_mode}. This review observed {record_count} records/locations and estimates {entity_estimate} measurement entities from the current bounded selection. If the provider returns the full cardinality cap, Open Data does not show that truncated list as if it were complete.

semantics.title: Adjust what the data means
semantics.description: Open Data inferred these meanings during import. Change them only when the source uses a different meaning. Different clocks and numeric fields can represent observation time, publication time, cumulative totals, interval amounts, event counts, status values, and more. Categories must not overlap.
